technology_attractiveness_reference.warning: These IRR, payback and investment figures are case-study/cluster estimates from the BEE compendium, not guaranteed project economics. The optimizer should recompute economics from user-specific capex, tariffs, operating hours, fuel prices and financing assumptions.

recommendation_rules.first_priority: Energy efficiency and loss reduction before fuel switching or electrification, unless safety, compliance or equipment replacement makes a different sequence necessary.
recommendation_rules.clean_steam_rule: Where steam directly contacts product or is used for critical sterilization, preserve required steam quality and validation; do not treat ordinary plant steam and clean/pure steam as interchangeable.
recommendation_rules.heat_pump_rule: Prefer heat pumps for low-temperature heat, hot-water duties and waste-heat upgrading; do not recommend them solely from the industry label without checking source temperature, sink temperature and required duty.
recommendation_rules.electric_boiler_rule: Recommend electric boilers when steam demand, required pressure, available electrical capacity, tariff and reliability make the option technically and economically feasible.
recommendation_rules.solar_thermal_rule: Prioritize solar thermal for suitable daytime low/medium-temperature thermal loads and boiler-feedwater/hot-water preheating; include thermal storage or backup where production continues outside solar hours.
recommendation_rules.biomass_rule: Recommend biomass only when sustainable local feedstock, delivered cost, storage, moisture/quality, boiler compatibility and emissions compliance are acceptable.
recommendation_rules.refrigeration_rule: Treat refrigeration and chillers as a major optimization target because BEE pharmaceutical-cluster data identifies refrigeration as a major energy-consuming system.
recommendation_rules.compressed_air_rule: Check pressure setpoints, leaks, loading, specific power and VFD suitability before replacing or expanding compressor capacity.
recommendation_rules.plant_specificity_rule: Never use the sector-level SEC, cluster fuel share, or a single case-study payback as a direct plant forecast.
